Petrified Wood, Trochus Shell, Irridescent Ammonite, Agate Geodes, Opaline Glass
A natural history themed small collection in oranges, browns, whites, and iridescent tones, with a total weight of 9.9 oz. See list below for descriptions of each object:
1) a 3"x 2.5" x1" polished specimen of vibrant orange, red, white, brown petrified wood, with a barcode sticker on the bottom that reads "Petrified wood specimen" $16.99
2) a 2" x 2" spiral trochus shell, strawberry banded with red marks at the top section agatinst the white and nacre/iridescent sections.
3) a 1.5" x 1" sliced and polished spiral ammonite, beautifully defined in brown and grey sections; the reverse side is brown with iridescent nacre with an opal effect.
4) 2 small agatized and banded crystal geode halves, polished centers. One is 1" x 2" and the other is 2" x1.5". One is marbled black and brown and rust colors with white; one is lighter brown/yellow gold with darker brown rust colors banded with white.
5) A small polished piece of opaline glass, which appears a milky blue white, but throws vibrant orange shadows in the light, much like an actual opal.
6) a 1.5" x 1" flake of a bronze coppery metallic surface rock; the other side is rougher and more matte.
